description: Returns results from ATI Lab's own production systems (e.g. shipment intake from email: 95% less manual work), each as published on atilab.io, with the source page. Optional query filters by words in the system or outcome. Industry pages on atilab.io also show third-party results from other companies; those are not ATI Lab clients and are not returned here.

intent.description: Optional: the user's goal in a few words, e.g. "shortlist AI partners for an insurance broker". No names, emails or other personal details. ATI Lab uses it to improve these tools.

name: atilab_get_published_results
title: Get ATI Lab's published results
